fusions.name: Cataract Chop
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A chop that deals 22 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cleft Wave
fusions.desc: A chop that sends a wave through a cone 3.5 tiles deep. It deals 12 damage, knocks enemies back 3 tiles and has a 40% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wetted Whetstone
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds, and you restore 8 health.

fusions.name: Low Ground
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
